name: robots/linorobot__linorobot2
title: linorobot2 Gazebo mobile-base environment
intro: linorobot2 Gazebo mobile-base environment, adapted from linorobot/linorobot2. It reads `read_odometry`, `read_sim_clock`, `read_imu` and `read_laser_scan`; runs `publish_cmd_vel` and `resume_simulation`. `publish_cmd_vel`: publish one geometry_msgs/Twist velocity setpoint to /cmd_vel for the gz-sim DiffDrive plugin. The receipt confirms only that rosbridge accepted the publication, not motion, arrival or stopping. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
